# DEV Community

> > A community platform for software developers to share articles, tutorials, and discussions on web development, JavaScript, CSS, APIs, and open-source technologies.

DEV Community is built on Forem, an open-source platform, and partnered with Major League Hacking (MLH). The community is led by Ben Halpern, Jess Lee, and Peter Frank, fostering collaboration among developers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- HTML5
- CSS
- HTTP
- REST API
- Forem
- Web Development
- Open Source
- jQuery
- Canvas
- three.js
- Developer Community
- Game Development
- MLH Partnership
- Code Examples

## About DEV Community

- [About DEV - DEV Community](https://dev.to/about): About DEV Community, Forem platform, and partnership with MLH

## Web Development Tutorials

- [CSS Grid : Auto-Fit & Auto-Fill - DEV Community](https://dev.to/nunocpnp/css-grid-auto-fit-auto-fill-4hkh): Guide to CSS Grid auto-fit and auto-fill with minmax for responsive layouts
- [Java Script Game Codes: 10+ The Best javascript games code - DEV Community](https://dev.to/gscode/10-best-of-javascript-games-3mjj): Collection of JavaScript game code examples using HTML5, CSS, and jQuery

## API and HTTP Guides

- [Handling HTTP Status Codes in a REST API (200 OK vs. 201 Created) - DEV Community](https://dev.to/msnmongare/handling-http-status-codes-in-a-rest-api-200-ok-vs-201-created-28d): Tutorial on REST API HTTP status codes: 200 OK vs 201 Created differences
- [How to use Basic authentication with curl? - DEV Community](https://dev.to/lucasg/how-to-use-basic-authentication-with-curl-1j6j): Tutorial on using Basic Auth with curl and HTTP authorization headers
